method.name: EX052-two-native-actual-and-intended-entry-cycle-diagnosis
procedure: Authenticate public EvidenceRef SHA and entire serialized EvaluationEvidence for original43 B0-TIME transport and new52 N0, current plan params/content/native identity and analysis hashes; five benchmark ledgers exact.
Partition every real closed and open cycle by actual [entry,exit) end-of-day fill-derived occupancy; match interval/route/status/prices separately from inherited quantity/fees/PnL.
Link five declared original-state conditional losses to real old entries and new same-date real decisions; never equate conditional losses to five deleted new trades.

Retain all grouping categories and account years, changed-cycle factual returns/amounts and opposite-policy actual daily holdings/fills, original and new entry native order budget facts. Reuse public existing annual cash/price/fee attribution rather than recompute hypothetical cash.
limits: Two realized full independent native policies only; no deletion/additive old-trade profit prediction, no counterfactual cash replay.
Overlap groups describe actual path correspondence, not a single-parameter causal trade replacement.
Same price interval may have different quantity/fees/net due to independently inherited native cash and integer-lot orders; each year normalized by its own opening equity.
No market reads, provider calls, prepare/evaluate, registration, formal evidence write or other-batch access. No change to frozen sources.
method.correction: First actual BUY may follow native entry or hold. Preserve declared actual firstfill signal_date/reason/route exact. Separately locate intended entry from contiguous native target1 prefix, preserving its locked route; no rewrite of actual cycle prices/dates/route or cash.
